summary: Fixed workspace-hijack in mcp-graph.js: added ORCH_WORKSPACE env override (const WS = process.env.ORCH_WORKSPACE || process.cwd(); post WS instead of cwd at startup). Env-unset preserves old cwd behavior; env-set targets that path independent of cwd. VERIFIED no hijack: ran headless arm from /tmp with ORCH_WORKSPACE=/Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude; daemon workspace stayed cloude (NOT /tmp), tasks=83, arm read 1 verdict from real graph. Workspace left on cloude. Not committed.
